title: the working folder changes mid-turn; ds-bot rejects the next step and switches part

actions.what: ask Builder for a three-read task, one tool call at a time
first tool done; move Builder to another working folder mid-turn

rescored.why: The original check looked only for a pre-step reject seen by the probe. The recorded sequence shows turn/end {kind:"blocked"} (DSH agent-loop: a pre-step reject ends the turn as blocked) right after the folder change, then a fresh part started from a handoff. ds-bot's listener sat outside the probe, so the reject never reached it. Check updated in drive-real.mjs; this run was re-scored from its own events, not re-run.
